KONFIGURATION FILE TO PICCOLINE  1984.11.06  KNEH
; iSBX351 baud rate.
 Baud rate =10h     ;  75 bps
 Baud rate =20h     ; 110 bps
 Baud rate =30h     ; 150 bps
 Baud rate =40h     ; 300 bps
 Baud rate =50h     ; 600 bps
 Baud rate =60h     ; 1200 bps
 Baud rate =70h     ; 2400 bps
 Baud rate =80h     ; 4800 bps
 Baud rate =90h     ; 9600 bps

; iSBX351 stop bits.
 Stop bits =04h     ; 1 stop bit
 Stop bits =08h     ; 1 1/2 stop bits
 Stop bits =0ch     ; 2 stop bits

; iSBX351 parity mode.
 Parity    =00h     ; no
 Parity    =01h     ; odd
 Parity    =03h     ; even

; iSBX351 databits
 Databits  =00h     ; 5 databits
 Databits  =80h     ; 6 databits
 Databits  =40h     ; 7 databits
 Databits  =C0h     ; 8 databits

; floppy timer.
*Flop tim  =02h     ;  2 sec
 Flop tim  =03h     ;  3 sec
 Flop tim  =04h	    ;  4 sec
 Flop tim  =05h     ;  5 sec
 Flop tim  =0Ah     ; 10 sec
 Flop tim  =14h     ; 20 sec
 Flop tim  =1Eh     ; 30 sec
 Flop tim  =28h     ; 40 sec
 Flop tim  =32h     ; 50 sec
 Flop tim  =3Ch     ; 60 sec
 Flop tim  =5Ah     ; 90 sec
 Flop tim  =78h     ;120 sec
 Flop tim  =B4h     ;180 sec
 Flop tim  =F0h     ;240 sec
 Flop tim  =12Ch    ;300 sec

; memory disk
 Mdisk     =00h     ; no
*Mdisk     =01h     ; 64kbytes
 Mdisk     =02h     ; 128kbytes
 Mdisk     =03h     ; 192kbytes
 Mdisk     =04h     ; 256kbytes

; iSBX type.
 Isbx type =00h     ; no
 Isbx type =01h     ; iSBX351
 Isbx type =02h     ; iSBX488

; foreground colour
 Colour    =01h     ; blue foreground
 Colour    =02h     ; green foreground
 Colour    =03h     ; cyan foreground
 Colour    =04h     ; red foreground
 Colour    =05h     ; magenta foreground
 Colour    =06h     ; yellow foreground
 Colour    =07h     ; white foreground

; initial state of rts(request to send)
 Rts       =00h     ; initial low
 Rts       =02h     ; initial high

#
